correctness.rationale: Represent each nonzero rank-one target B=u beta and each factor by u alpha with alpha(u)=1. The count of idempotents causing transition alpha->beta is H if equal, 0 if distinct proportional, and q^{n-2} otherwise. The exact matrix T=q^{n-2}(J-E)+H I has projections J/N, E/g-J/N, I-E/g and eigenvalues q^{2n-2},q^{n-2},q^{n-1}; summing T^{r-1} over H first forms gives every trace-class fiber, while row sum gives zero fiber. Handles q=2 (third projector zero), n=2, r=1, and zero target. Independently enumerated all targets for q=2,n=2,r<=4; q=3,n=2,r<=3; q=2,n=3,r<=3.

value.rationale: An exact natural finite-field matrix factorization census with trace-stratified fibers, exact survival probability and mixing rates, rather than an isolated small matrix calculation. Useful for semigroup random walks and constrained matrix products.

final_claim: For every prime power q, n>=2 and r>=1, complete fibers of products of r rank-one idempotents in M_n(Fq) depend only on zero and rank-one target trace classes via a three-eigenvalue transition matrix; nonzero survival probability is (q^{2n-2}/m)^{r-1}.
